title: Refine engine: clean()/structure() + the 3-model litmus test

steps: read refine.mjs, tidy.js, Revise.js, ask-each.mjs, Refine.js, Refine readme
extend Servex/agents/tidy.js clean prompt (lean, no glossary stuffing)
build clean() in ext/Refine/refine.js: numbered sentences, mechanical strike/glossary/reject checks
build structure() in ext/Refine/structure.js: reuse refine.mjs's structured prompt, every-sentence-once check
build Server/refine-litmus.mjs: 3 wired cheap models (haiku, deepseek, gpt-6-luna), mechanical pass/fail
set.outcome:
**Landed: the shared refine() engine (clean + structure) and the 3-model litmus test.**

- [x] clean(text, {prev}): engine.js — numbered sentences, mechanical glossary/strike/reject checks, lean model prompt (no glossary sent)
- [x] clean = near-verbatim, code-enforced: a diff-check rejects an invented word unless a glossary fix or self-correction explains it
- [x] structure(sentences): structure.js — reuses refine.mjs's own prompt, fails loudly on a missing or duplicated sentence
- [x] litmus: all 3 wired cheap models passed; haiku cheapest ($0.15) but slowest (123s vs 8s/26s)

One incident caught and fixed mid-task — see doc/refine-engine.md.
